# VA Job Brief

Use this skill when the user says “make it like a real editing studio” or when a project starts.

## Checklist (keep it short)
- Deliverable + target platform (YouTube/IG/MLS)
- Target duration range
- Pacing (slow/medium/fast)
- Must-include rooms + priority order
- Constraints (privacy, no faces, brand)
- Suggested style preset (`youtubepro` by default)

## Output template
- Deliverable:
- Target duration:
- Pacing:
- Must-include:
- Nice-to-have:
- Constraints:
- Style preset:

## Defaults
- If unknown: YouTube walkthrough, 2–4 minutes, medium pacing, subtle ramps, minimal gimmicks.
